about_the_game:
Message panel attachment items that display above the player character's head. Choose from 10 different messages.

Ouch! Panel: Give me a break!

Ouch! Panel: Sauna

*Open [DLC] under the [Item] page in the main menu and select new items to receive them.
*After unlocking costumes, apply them via [EQUIP] -> [Costumes] in the main menu.
